races.race_name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Silver Kiss
runners.spotlight: Debut third at Fairyhouse (6f, good) looks good subsequently given the winner, Livenka, won the Ballyhane Stakes next time and the runner-up won a maiden by 9l; filled the same spot at Galway last time (7f, yielding) and the second horse filled the same spot in a Listed race next time; chance.
runners.comment: Okay third on debut and improved despite filling same spot at Galway; chance

runners.name: Star Glory
runners.spotlight: Close second over this trip at Leopardstown, third has won since; disappointed over 7f at Galway last time but the yielding ground was possibly to blame; worth another go on good ground but this is a competitive race.
runners.comment: Close second in July; worth another chance on good ground after disappointment last time

runners.name: Lunar Empress
runners.spotlight: No match for easy winner Folsom Blues at Gowran (7f, soft); fifth behind winning stablemate at Galway (7f, yielding) last time (3.75l behind Silver Kiss) after being bumped early on; Foley takes over now.
runners.comment: 3.75l behind Silver Kiss at Galway on her second start when bumped early on; Foley on now

runners.name: Maeda Matsu
runners.spotlight: Good first effort when chasing home the useful Livenka in the valuable Ballyhane Stakes at Naas despite a price of 100-1; withdrawn from a Cork Listed contest a couple of days ago due to coughing but clearly well thought of; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Chased home useful Livenka in Ballyhane Stakes on debut; shortlisted

runners.name: Miss Twilight
runners.spotlight: Ran a stormer on her debut when third of 12 at Leopardstown (7f, good), a neck behind a rival who won by 5l next time; could progress further with that run under her belt; interesting, but drawn wide.
runners.comment: Ran a stormer on debut when third, neck behind subsequent easy winner; interesting

runners.name: Green Nature
runners.spotlight: One of two for yard; Cracksman filly; 160,000euros yearling; dam Group-placed 5f 2yo winner (RPR 102), half-sister to winners Manaccan (5f Group 3), Raucous (6f Listed) and Green Fortune (6f inc 2yo), out of Group-placed 5f 2yo winner; market best guide.
runners.comment: 160,000euros yearling; dam Group-placed 5f 2yo winner; market best guide

runners.name: Autumn Gray
runners.spotlight: Saxon Warrior filly; 95,000euros yearling; sixth foal; half-sister to winners Diagnostic (6f-7f AW; RPR 100), Homeopathic (7f AW 2yo/turf; 94), Wizard D'Amour (7f inc AW; 93) and Naturopath (Greek 6f); dam unraced sister to 6f Listed winner Prescription; best watched unless market speaks.
runners.comment: 95,000euros yearling; half-sister to four winners; best watched unless market speaks

runners.name: Estado De La Luna
runners.spotlight: State Of Rest filly; 80,000gns yearling; second foal; dam ran once at 1m2f (RPR 66), sister to 8.6f Listed winner Up Helly AA, half-sister to French 7f/7.5f winner Innervisions, out of 1m Group1 winning half-sister to Italian 1m 2yo Group 3/US 1m2f Grade 2 winner Innit; market can sort trainer's two.
runners.comment: 80,000gns yearling; dam ran once at 1m2f (RPR 66); market can sort trainer's two

runners.name: Reyika
runners.spotlight: Sea The Moon filly; half-sister to 1m2f winner Reyenzi (RPR 108); dam unplaced 1m AW/9.4f turf (55), half-sister to winners Raydara (7f 2yo Group 2), Rondonia (1m/1m2f) and Rayna (1m3f/1m4f), out of 1m4f Listed winner; appears stable number one on jockey bookings.
runners.comment: Half-sister to stable's 1m2f winner Reyenzi (RPR 108); appears stable number one
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Armarone's Girl
runners.spotlight: Defied odds of 66-1 when finishing a head in front of Churchill Bond and 3l behind Miss Twilight at Leopardstown on debut when sixth (7f, good); that's something to build on.
runners.comment: Defied 66-1 odds when sixth on debut, 3l behind Miss Twilight; something to build on

runners.name: Lusted
runners.spotlight: Improved over a dismal Leopardstown debut when a 6l fifth of 13 over 1m at Dundalk eight days ago; others preferred all the same.
runners.comment: Improved over dismal debut when fifth of 13 last time; others preferred though

runners.name: Churchill Bond
runners.spotlight: Pinatubo filly cost 300,000euros at the Arqana breeze-ups; sent off 100-30 for her Leopardstown (7f, good) debut but was a shade disappointing in seventh; 3l to find with Miss Twilight on that initial outing but likely to improve.
runners.comment: Cost 300,000euros at breeze-ups; 3l to find with Miss Twilight after fair debut

runners.name: Coastal Wonder
runners.spotlight: Finished 5.25l behind Miss Twilight on debut at Leopardstown (7f, good, 14-1); work to do.
runners.comment: Finished 5.25l behind Miss Twilight on debut at Leopardstown; work to do

runners.name: Arizonaneargalway
runners.spotlight: Triple-figure odds for all three maidens and makes little appeal on her form to date.
runners.comment: Triple-figure odds for all three maidens and makes little appeal on her form to date

runners.name: Scarlet Dream
runners.spotlight: First reserve; promise in her seventh of 14 over 6f at Dundalk six days ago; should progress.
runners.comment: Reserve; promise in her seventh of 14 on AW debut; should progress

runners.name: Wecouldavehaditall
runners.spotlight: Well beaten at Galway on debut over 7f (yielding); much improvement needed.
runners.comment: Well beaten at Galway on debut over 7f (yielding); much improvement needed

runners.name: Bex Noir
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; 300-1 on her debut at Dundalk and beaten 18l.
runners.comment: Reserve; 300-1 on her debut at Dundalk and beaten 18l

races.race_name: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Argentarius
runners.spotlight: Finished first in a barrier trial; excellent effort in a Cork maiden (6f, good) when beaten 0.5l into second by subsequent Group 3 winner Ballinea Star; didn't improve at Galway (7f, yielding) when fourth but it was still a creditable effort; should be thereabouts again.
runners.comment: Excellent second on rules debut and creditable fourth last time; thereabouts again

runners.name: Alfresco
runners.spotlight: No Nay Never filly; 250,000euros yearling; eighth foal; half-sister to winners Prague (1m/1m2f inc Group 2; RPR 118), Knight Of Honour (1m1f-1m6f inc Bahrain; 95), Glyfada (1m/10.4f; 94) and Princess Nadia (1m2f; 86); dam 6f 2yo winner (inc Group 3/AW; 110); nice pedigree and worth checking in the market.
runners.comment: 250,000euros yearling; half-sister to Gr.2 winner Prague (RPR 118); check market

runners.name: Lady H
runners.spotlight: St Mark's Basilica filly; 105,000euros yearling, 190,000euros 2yo; third foal; half-sister to winners Midnight Tango (Group-placed 6f 2yo; RPR 104) and Fernando (1m 2yo; 73); dam Group-placed 6f 2yo winner (103), half-sister to 5f Group 1 winner Makarova; interesting newcomer and worth a market check.
runners.comment: 190,000euros breeze-up purchase; half-sister to two winners; interesting newcomer

runners.name: Red Primrose
runners.spotlight: Shaped as though this trip was what she wanted when running on late for third over 5f here in June (good), second, fourth and fifth subsequently won a maiden; big player.
runners.comment: Looked in need of 6f when keeping on for third on debut and form boosted since; player

runners.name: Formous
runners.spotlight: Starman filly was purchased for 360,000euros at a breeze-up in May; sister to Qatari 6.5f 2yo winner Smartman; dam unraced half-sister to 5f/6f Group 1 winner Fairyland and Australian 7f Group 2 winner Now Or Never, out of unraced half-sister to 6f-7f Group 1 winner Dream Ahead; of obvious interest if market support arrives.
runners.comment: 360,000euros breeze-up purchase; dam unraced half-sister to 5f/6f Group 1 winner Fairyland

runners.name: Timeless Tale
runners.spotlight: Sioux Nation filly; fifth foal; half-sister to 5f-8.5f winner Wakanaka (inc 2yo/Canadian Grade 2/Italian Group 3; RPR 105); dam 5f winner (71), out of 5f 2yo winner closely related to useful 5f-7f winner Green Park, half-sister to 5f 2yo Group 3 winner Whitbarrow; market can guide.
runners.comment: Half-sister to Wakanaka (RPR 105); dam 5f winner; market can guide

runners.name: Pink Venom
runners.spotlight: One of two for yard; showed the benefit of an initial run (seventh of ten at Leopardstown) when third at Fairyhouse (6f, good); could challenge for the money.
runners.comment: Showed benefit of initial run when third at F'house last time; could challenge for money

runners.name: Annie Tips
runners.spotlight: Dropped away to finish in rear when 66-1 for her debut at Fairyhouse; improved effort when a 4.25l eighth of 16 at Cork last time (5f, good); more needed all the same.
runners.comment: Finished in rear on debut but a bit better last time; more needed

runners.name: Fahrana
runners.spotlight: Mehmas filly; half-sister to 6f 2yo/7f AW winner Dublin Bay (RPR 91); dam twice-raced maiden (78), out of US 9.5f Grade 3 winning sister to Australian 1m4f Group 2 winner Yucatan, is granddaughter of triple 1m Group 1 winner Six Perfections; Pink Venom appears to be the stable's main hope.
runners.comment: Half-sister to 6f/7f AW winner Dublin Bay (RPR 91); Pink Venom appears yard's main hope
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Katsuit
runners.spotlight: Dam unraced half-sister to winners Grandmaster Flash (useful 1m4f/2m) and Glens Top Cat (Australian 1m2f-1m7f), out of 1m4f winning half-sister to 7f/1m Group 3 winner Purr Along; best watched.
runners.comment: Dam unraced half-sister to two winners over further; best watched.

runners.name: Sorrento Sunset
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to US 5f/6.5f turf winner Sorrento Sky; unraced dam out of unraced half-sister to 5f Listed winner Our Little Secret (dam of 5f Group 2 winner Pearl Secret); likely best watched.
runners.comment: Half-sister to US 5f/6.5f turf winner Sorrento Sky; likely best watched

runners.name: Film Set
runners.spotlight: Should improve from an initial run at Fairyhouse (6f, good) where she was tenderly handled; race won by the useful-looking Livenka.
runners.comment: Should improve from initial run at F'house where she was tenderly handled
runners.owner: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith

runners.name: A Girl Named Sioux
runners.spotlight: Beaten 22l on debut at Leopardstown (7f, good, 50-1); best to look elsewhere despite added hood.
runners.comment: Beaten 22l on debut at Leopardstown (50-1); best to look elsewhere

runners.name: Stormy Dawn
runners.spotlight: Unlikely to feature based on two moderate efforts to date.
runners.comment: Unlikely to feature based on two moderate efforts to date

runners.name: Sadie Rose
runners.spotlight: The hood she wore for her debut over this trip at Dundalk is discarded after she finished 12th of 14 (150-1); ruled out.
runners.comment: Hood is discarded after she was 12th of 14 at Dundalk on debut at 150-1

races.race_name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Zoar
runners.spotlight: Ran a cracker on debut over C&D (good) for Josh Halley, travelling sweetly and beaten just 2.25l into second behind subsequent Goodwood Group 2 winner Man's Best Friend; has since joined Donnacha O'Brien and obvious chance here.
runners.comment: Promising debut behind subsequent Gr' 2 winner over C&D, new yard, obvious chance

runners.name: Roeillaun
runners.spotlight: Left form of previous two runs behind when almost springing a 50-1 surprise at the Curragh (6f, good) a week ago; this is probably a better race so she'll need to improve further if she is to get her head in front.
runners.comment: Almost sprang surprise last week at the Curragh, this is probably a better race

runners.name: Unlawfilly
runners.spotlight: Minzaal filly; E15,000 breeze-up purchase; dam 1m winner (RPR 84), half-sister to winners Shaden (6f 2yo Group 3) and I'll Be Your Clown (1m2f-10.5f Flat/2m hurdle), out of Listed-placed 5f 2yo winner; likely best watched.
runners.comment: E15,000 Minzaal filly, dam 1m winner, likely best watched on debut

runners.name: Don't Go Mad
runners.spotlight: Unfortunately gelding; E20,000 yearling; half-brother to winners Tomahawk King (7f AW 2yo; RPR 76), Berry Edge (1m1f/1m2f Flat inc AW, 74; 2m hurdle) and Al Zaker (Hungarian 7f); dam 1m winner; likely best watched.
runners.comment: Unfortunately gelding, dam 1m winner, likely best watched on debut

runners.name: Sapphire Sun
runners.spotlight: Starspangledbanner filly; E28,000 foal, E40,000 yearling; dam 6f winner (RPR 76), sister to winners Broken Stones (Group-placed 6f 2yo) and Usra (Listed-placed 5f 2yo), half-sister to 1m 2yo/1m2f winner Piecederesistance; market best guide.
runners.comment: Starspangledbanner filly, dam 1m 2yo winner, market best guide

runners.name: Catch The Boss
runners.spotlight: Calyx filly; E36,000 yearling; half-sister to winners Universal Girl (South African 6f) and Future Promise (Danish 7.7f); dam unraced sister to 1m1f Listed winner Qazyna, half-sister to Australian 1m4f Group 2 winner Au Revoir; market can reveal expectations.
runners.comment: E36,000 Calyx filly, half sister to winners at 6f/7f, market can reveal expectations
runners.owner: John G Hennessy & C Acheson & Mrs John Harrington

runners.name: Elzante
runners.spotlight: Elzaam gelding; E7,500 yearling; half-brother to 5f 2yo winner Call Me Harswell (RPR 78); dam unplaced, half-sister to US 1m Grade 1 winner River Boyne; best watched unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: E7,500 Elzaam gelding, dam unplaced, best watched unless market speaks

runners.name: Bajans
runners.spotlight: Sergei Prokofiev filly; 27,000GBP breeze-up purchase; dam placed 6f 2yo/7f (RPR 72), out of 1m1f/1m2f winning sister to 1m4f/2m Group 3 winner Nayef Road; mix of speed and stamina in pedigree; probably best watched unless backed.
runners.comment: Sergei Prokofiev filly a 27,000GBP breeze up buy, watch unless backed

runners.name: Eyeconic
runners.spotlight: Starspangledbanner filly; E70,000 yearling; dam placed 6f turf/7f AW (RPR 76), half-sister to winners Roulston Scar (useful 5f-6f), Special Purpose (useful 5f 2yo) and Rising Power (5f/6f 2yo); yard can ready one and some appeal on paper; check market.
runners.comment: E70,000 Starspangledbanner filly, dam related to 2yo winners, check market
runners.owner: Mrs J Barrett & Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs M V Magnier

runners.name: Miss Cashman Hooke
runners.spotlight: Starspangledbanner filly; E45,000 yearling; half-sister to four winners inc Assail (9.4f-1m4f inc AW; RPR 96), Sarsons Risk (1m4f/2m Flat inc AW, 90; 2m hurdle) and Glengowan (1m 2yo; 85); dam 1m4f winner (82); may need further in time.
runners.comment: Starspangledbanner filly, dam 1m4f winner, may need further in time

runners.name: Kilcullen
runners.spotlight: Sioux Nation colt; 50,000gns yearling; dam unraced half-sister to winners King Leonidas (useful 7f 2yo/1m), Ziryab (7.5f-10.7f inc Australia) and Rasmee (12.4f), out of UAE 9.5f Listed winner; yard not known for debut 2yo winners.
runners.comment: 50,000gns Sioux Nation colt, dam unraced, yard not known for debut 2yo winners

runners.name: Capital Of Pride
runners.spotlight: Far from disgraced on debut at Cork (5f, gd-fm) when ducking left at the start but finishing just 2.75l behind the 95 rated Hanney Boy, to whom he was conceding 4lb; dam won over 6f as a 2yo so this longer trip should be fine; chance.
runners.comment: Promising introduction behind 95 rated rival at Cork, should get 6f, chance

runners.name: Panhandle
runners.spotlight: Yard in fine form but this gelding didn't pull up any trees on debut at Navan last month; much more needed.
runners.comment: No impact on debut at Navan, yard in form but much more needed
runners.owner: Gerard Clarke/Seven Plus One Syndicate/Patrick McGuinness

runners.name: Magma King
runners.spotlight: 25-1 and weakened in the closing stages on debut at Leopardstown (6.5f, good); much more needed.
runners.comment: 25-1 and weakened in the closing stages on debut at Leopardstown, much more needed

runners.name: Jisir
runners.spotlight: 200-1 and didn't show a whole lot on debut at Galway; may need more time and experience.
runners.comment: 200-1 and didn't show much on debut at Galway, may need more time
runners.owner: Mohammed Bin Hamad Khalifa Al Attiyah

races.race_name: Tally-Ho Stud Irish EBF Ballyogan Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)

runners.name: Havana Anna
runners.spotlight: Last season's Cheveley Park runner up didn't have to be at her best to win the Group 3 Lacken Stakes here back in May; only beaten 2l when a fine fourth in the Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot; didn't fire dropped to 5f in a Curragh Group 2 on latest; likely to rebound stepped back up in trip and gets 3yo weight allowance.
runners.comment: C&D winner, fourth in Commonwealth Cup, can rebound from poor run over 5f on latest

runners.name: First Instinct
runners.spotlight: 4yo represents last year's winning yard; four-time winner including at Listed and Group 3 level; slow start to this season but back on song when denied by a neck by Flora Of Bermuda in a York Group 3 (6f, gd-fm) last month; firmly enters calculations now.
runners.comment: Listed and Gr'3 winner, yard won this last year, fine run at York latest, big chance

runners.name: Soul Love
runners.spotlight: Two wins last season including at Listed level at Goodwood (6f, good); fine third in York Group 3 on seasonal return (1.5l behind First Instinct); had a few of these rivals behind when taking a Listed race over C&D in July; gets 3yo weight allowance and likely to be on the premises again.
runners.comment: Two-time Listed winner including over C&D latest, likely to be on the premises again

runners.name: Dancing Saxon
runners.spotlight: Enjoying a fine campaign; won a 6.5f (good) rated race at Limerick on seasonal return; got to within 0.5l of Soul Love when second of 15 in C&D Listed race here last month; regained the winning thread in impressive fashion off favourable mark in a 7f (yielding) Galway handicap; progressive and should be thereabouts again.
runners.comment: Progressive filly, closely matched with Soul Love, easy h'cap win latest, thereabouts

runners.name: Treasure Rose
runners.spotlight: Successive handicap wins at Down Royal (7f, soft) and Fairyhouse (6f, good) earlier this summer; shaped okay on first try in Listed company over C&D on penultimate (behind Soul Love and Dancing Saxon) and not disgraced over 7f at Cork in another Listed race on latest; needs more upped in grade.
runners.comment: Dual h'cap winner, not disgraced in Listed company last twice, needs more up in grade

runners.name: Focaccia
runners.spotlight: Well held behind a few of these in C&D Listed race won by Soul Love last month; beaten off 80 in Curragh handicap on latest; up against it in this company.
runners.comment: Beaten off 80 in Curragh handicap on latest, up against it in this company

runners.name: Chantez
runners.spotlight: 4yo hasn't won since her 2yo days but not beaten far the last twice, in a Group 3 at Leopardstown (7f, good) and when a 3l fourth of 15 in a Listed contest over C&D (good) a month ago (behind Soul Love and Dancing Saxon); a fair bit to find on the figures with a few of these.
runners.comment: Behind two of these in Listed over C&D latest, a fair bit to find on the figures here

runners.name: Temperance
runners.spotlight: Has been highly tried to no avail since winning a C&D handicap in May last year off 75; not disgraced in 7f Listed race at Cork last time out but this looks too demanding.
runners.comment: Highly tried to no avail since C&D handicap win last year, this looks too demanding

races.race_name: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap

runners.name: I'm Spartacus
runners.spotlight: All seven wins came over 6f (has run well at 5f) and six of them on AW; turf breakthrough in June when scoring at Fairyhouse (6f, good) by 2.5l off 3lb lower; moderate efforts since, including when beaten by 5.5l at Cork last time (6f, good to firm); others preferred.
runners.comment: Seven-time winner made turf breakthrough in June but moderate since; others preferred

runners.name: Hasiyna
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner at Dundalk over 5f/6f but 0-16 on turf; remains 2lb above her last winning mark and not as effective on this surface.
runners.comment: Three-time winner on AW but 0-16 on turf; remains 2lb above last winning mark

runners.name: Steel Magnolia
runners.spotlight: Won a Bellewstown handicap in October (5f, soft) off 2lb higher; running well in defeat this season, not least when runner-up behind her reopposing stablemate Dandy Land over C&D last time (good); 1.25l to find with that rival but better off at the weights; suited by softer.
runners.comment: Runner-up to Dandy Land over C&D latest; remains 2lb below winning mark

runners.name: Tawaazon
runners.spotlight: Nine-time winner, five on turf; latest win came here over 6f in May 2025 off 8lb higher; good runs in defeat over C&D this term, the best when runner-up off 1lb higher in June; fourth here last time when 3.25l behind Dandy Land; don't rule him out.
runners.comment: Won off 8lb higher here last year; good C&D runs in defeat this term; not ruled out

runners.name: Smart Sioux
runners.spotlight: Ran her best race when staying-on sixth in a C&D fillies' maiden last year; poor since but some positives in her 5.5l seventh of 12 at Cork (5f, good) last time; down 3lb but others preferred.
runners.comment: Ran best race over C&D last year; slight positives in her seventh of 12 last time at Cork

runners.name: Dandy Land
runners.spotlight: Worked his way up the placings from third at Bellewstown to second at Down Royal before winning here last time, all over 5f on good; had a few of these behind him when winning; up 7lb but Paddy Harnett is entitled to use his 3lb claim this time, so that helps; in the mix.
runners.comment: Had a few of these behind when winning over C&D last time; up 7lb but rider's claim helps

runners.name: Nebrook Star
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise in Britain at two; not beaten too far on yard debut in a Curragh handicap off 7lb higher after a slow start; shade disappointing in maiden company at Dundalk last time; interesting to see what position she occupies in the market.
runners.comment: Not beaten far on stable debut last month but disappointing in m'den company latest

runners.name: Gordon Bennett
runners.spotlight: Best form in 2022, winning three times in a July-to-September spell, and rising to a career-high mark of 94; frustrating in recent seasons; joined Peter Fahey late last year after a claiming-race third on AW; stumbled out of the stalls over 7f at Leopardstown earlier this month, left with too much to do; capable of better.
runners.comment: Best form in 2022, reaching peak mark of 94; too much to do last time; capable of better

runners.name: Lismacbryan
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in a 6f Curragh handicap off 53 in 2024; failed to beat a rival in a Navan handicap nor a Fairyhouse claimer in what were his final two starts for his former yard; hood goes on now but hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival in two starts this season; hard to fancy on stable debut

runners.name: Whatswrongnow
runners.spotlight: Winless from 34 starts but has been consistent this year from 5f to 7f; beaten 1.75l into fifth at Down Royal on penultimate (5f, good) but below his best at Cork (6f, good to firm); place chance at his best.
runners.comment: 0-34 but consistent this year; place chance if bouncing back from moderate effort latest

runners.name: Pansy Poe
runners.spotlight: Now 0-15 and was beaten 20l in a Dundalk claimer when last seen in September (6f); new stable but best watched.
runners.comment: Now 0-15 and beaten 20l in a claimer when last seen; new stable but best watched

runners.name: Niobite
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in three deep maidens and didn't improve for switch to handicaps at Cork last month (6f, good to firm, 50-1).
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in three deep maidens and didn't improve for switch to handicaps at Cork

runners.name: Simmering Seas
runners.spotlight: Ran her best race on stable debut for a third trainer over 5f at Cork nine days ago when sent off the 11-4 favourite and keeping on late for second; that was a first run for 125 days, she's out again quickly but interesting if her supporters return.
runners.comment: Ran best race on stable bow latest when 2nd (11-4 fav'); interesting if supporters return

runners.name: Step Back In Time
runners.spotlight: All four wins came over 5f/6f at Navan; out of form until taking the third spot behind Dandy Land and Steel Magnolia over C&D last time (good); nudged up 2lb but won off a mark of 51 in October; needs to back up that latest positive run.
runners.comment: Four-time winner at Navan; out of form until third over C&D latest; must back it up

runners.name: Amanirenas
runners.spotlight: A 6f Laytown winner in September off 46; five wins at 6f/7f; has never run over this trip so may lack the speed to match some of these, especially returning from a 331-day absence.
runners.comment: Won at Laytown in Sept' but may lack speed to match these over 5f on return

runners.name: Little Roy
runners.spotlight: Didn't show much in three maidens for John O'Neill; goes handicapping now for new yard but probably best watched.
runners.comment: Didn't show much in three maidens for former yard; makes h'cap debut but best watched

runners.name: Aurora Nova
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner (three at this trip) on good ground; poor form shown in her last three outings but drops into this lower grade for the first time since April 2025, and that resulted in a victory, so don't rule her out.
runners.comment: Poor form recently but last time she dropped to this grade she won so don't rule her out

runners.name: Menwirr
runners.spotlight: Showed modest form in four starts for Archie Watson; rating of 60 may flatter him; best watched on stable debut.
runners.comment: Showed modest form in four runs for Archie Watson; possibly flattered by OR of 60

runners.name: Prada's World
runners.spotlight: Unseen for over a year after finishing in midfield in a Navan 5f handicap in April last year (soft); down 12lb compared to that and this is a lower grade, so worth a look in the market.
runners.comment: Off 484 days since midfield in a h'cap; down 12lb and drops to lower grade so check market

races.race_name: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Tero d'Rosa
runners.spotlight: Won on seasonal return at Ballinrobe in May (9.5f, gd-yld); raised 7lb for that and has run well enough without really threatening to win in three starts since; probably in the handicapper's grip for now.
runners.comment: Raised 7lb for win on seasonal return, probably in the handicapper's grip for now

runners.name: Eastern Peace
runners.spotlight: AW winner shaped nicely on seasonal reappearance at Leopardstown (1m2f, good) and stayed on nicely enough over 1m1f back there on latest; drops in grade and could go well upped in trip.
runners.comment: Stayed on nicely over 1m1f latest, drops in grade, could go well upped in trip
runners.owner: Martin W Walsh & Tony Carey & Brian Murray & Mark Hopkins

runners.name: Showyoutheropes
runners.spotlight: Won over 1m2f (gd-fm) at Newmarket for Tom Clover when wearing a visor and that returns here; needs to rebound from a heavy defeat at Galway but soft ground not ideal there; these conditions more suitable and yard going well now; chance.
runners.comment: Visor worn for sole success returns, ground not ideal latest, yard going well, chance

runners.name: Derry Lad
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won since 2023 but the handicapper is relenting and he was only beaten 1l when fifth over 1m7f at Leopardstown last time; not beaten far over C&D in June off 4lb higher under this rider; in the mix.
runners.comment: Not beaten far latest, ran well over C&D in June off 4lb higher, in the mix

runners.name: Yquem
runners.spotlight: First reserve; scored off basement mark at Leopardstown in June; not far away off revised mark in three runs since and just didn't quite get home upped to 1m4f at Roscommon last time; place shout back in trip.
runners.comment: Won off 10lb lower in June, solid form since, didn't get 1m4f latest, place shout; reserve

runners.name: God Knows
runners.spotlight: Two-time winner hasn't really fired this year but she did run on well from the back over 7f at Leopardstown last time so return to this longer trip a plus; soundly beaten in a division of this race last season off 11lb higher; others preferred.
runners.comment: Stayed on okay latest over 7f, longer trip a plus, soundly beaten over C&D a year ago

runners.name: Signor Ferrari
runners.spotlight: Is on a dangerous mark and it wasn't a bad effort on return from 419 days off at Bellewstown last month; should strip fitter now and has won twice at just short of this trip at Dundalk; not discounted.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark, strip fitter for latest, this trip within range, not discounted

runners.name: Wie Wunderbar
runners.spotlight: Showed ability in three starts in Germany; bought for E55,000 at Arqana last month and makes handicap debut; market can reveal expectations on first run for Jessica Harrington.
runners.comment: Ability in Germany, bought for E55,000, market best guide on stable/h'cap debut

runners.name: Glittering Gem
runners.spotlight: Handicap debutante produced her best run when beaten a neck in a Sligo claimer; remote fourth in a Tramore maiden eight days ago; not obviously well treated and probably best watched.
runners.comment: Handicap debutante, best run in Sligo claimer, not obviously well treated, watch

runners.name: Sinbad My Dad
runners.spotlight: Won off 4lb lower last year; hinted at a return to form at Leopardstown on penultimate but jockey reported he stopped quickly back there on latest; may need a bit more help from the handicapper.
runners.comment: Remains 4lb above only win, reportedly stopped quickly on latest at Leopardstown
runners.owner: Mrs Helen Butler & John A Griffin & Mrs Bernadette Fahey

runners.name: Covert Legend
runners.spotlight: AW winner in Britain posted a solid effort on Irish and stable debut at the Curragh in June but hasn't gone on from that; down the field over C&D on latest and same mark now; visor worn that day discarded; needs more.
runners.comment: Promising start for this yard but hasn't gone on from it, down the field over C&D latest

runners.name: God Of Thunder
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles and on the Flat (12.5f) at Limerick last year; ran well over timber at Sligo on his penultimate start in a claimer but heavy defeat back on the Flat at Tramore (2m) on latest; well handicapped but needs to rebound back in trip.
runners.comment: Heavy defeat back on Flat on latest, well handicapped but needs to rebound

runners.name: Walls Cross
runners.spotlight: Showed little in maidens and similar story on handicap debut at Gowran on latest (9.5f, gd-fm) when beaten 17l; dropped 4lb but hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: Beaten 17l on handicap debut latest, dropped 4lb but hard to make a case for

runners.name: Millhone
runners.spotlight: Getting the hang of things in handicaps and has gone close the last twice, including when beaten 0.5l over C&D early last month; same margin of defeat at Cork latest over 1m4f (gd-fm); nudged up another 4lb but big player again.
runners.comment: Narrowly denied last twice including over C&D, nudged up 4lb but big player again
runners.owner: N J Hitchins & Mrs John M Weld

runners.name: Parish Team
runners.spotlight: Hasn't shown a whole lot in three maidens at 1m1f-1m5f; potential improver on handicap debut but his opening mark doesn't look overly generous.
runners.comment: Handicap debutant, modest form in maidens, opening mark not overly generous

runners.name: Miss Ivor
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; very modest form in maidens and handicaps so far; 80-1 when beaten 14.5l on latest at Gowran; impossible to fancy.
runners.comment: Very modest form in maidens and handicaps, impossible to fancy; reserve

runners.name: Maralinga
runners.spotlight: Losing run stretches back to 2023 and recent form over hurdles have not suggested a return to the winner's enclosure is imminent; can only be watched back on the Flat.
runners.comment: On long losing run, in poor form over hurdles, can only watch back on the level

runners.name: Amavasya
runners.spotlight: Shed the maiden tag at the twelfth time of asking on latest at Fairyhouse (1m2f, good) under a well-judged ride; raised 6lb and moves up in grade so will need a career best to follow up.
runners.comment: Off the mark on latest, up 6lb and in class, will need career best to follow up

races.race_name: TRM BIOACTIVE Energy Boost Handicap

runners.name: Alice Monet
runners.spotlight: Two wins last year and ran a fine race when a close fourth in the Listed Galtres Stakes at York (1m4f, gd-fm); pleasing comeback run at Sligo 18 days ago and sharper now; player off the same mark.
runners.comment: Pleasing comeback run at Sligo 18 days ago, sharper now, same mark, player

runners.name: Quatre Bras
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner is 0-22 on turf but has placed on multiple occasions; not beaten far on last turf start at Leopardstown last month (1m, good) and kept on steadily for a 3.5l sixth of 14 over 10.5f at Dundalk latest; eased another 1lb and becoming well handicapped; chance.
runners.comment: Signs of life on last two runs, starting to become well handicapped, chance

runners.name: Minella Rockett
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on hurdling debut at Limerick last month and followed up with a first Flat win at Galway (9.5f, yielding), showing a willing attitude to score by a neck; 4lb rise more than negated by rider's 7lb claim but has to prove stamina for this longer trip (bred to stay but well beaten both previous starts at 1m2f-1m4f).
runners.comment: Up 4lb for win over 9.5f at Galway, stamina to prove for this longer distance

runners.name: Akecheta
runners.spotlight: Two wins on heavy ground, a Tipperary maiden and a conditions race at Gowran last September; yet to win a handicap and out of sorts on last two runs at Gowran; coming down the weights but others arrive in better form.
runners.comment: Both wins on heavy ground, out of sorts last twice, others arrive in better form

runners.name: Diamond Exchange
runners.spotlight: Two wins this season, over 1m2f at Leopardstown in May off 77 and on latest when swooping late to score by a head over C&D off 79; a 3lb rise for that seems reasonable and likely to give another good account.
runners.comment: Two wins this season, scored by a head over C&D latest, up 3lb, go well again
runners.owner: Bronsan Racing & H Redknapp & John Breslin

runners.name: Guardian Of Realm
runners.spotlight: Five runs for Ger Lyons included three placings on the AW and a 6l win in a fillies' maiden at Fairyhouse (1m2f, good, runner up won a maiden by 5l next start); since bought for 210,000gns and has joined Denis Hogan; could be on a nice mark for her handicap debut and worth checking in the market.
runners.comment: Fairyhouse maiden winner bought for 210,000gns, handicap debutante, check market

runners.name: Ob La Di
runners.spotlight: Last win came over C&D just over a year ago off 4lb lower; starting to come into form now, solid fifth at the Curragh in June (1m2f, gd-fm) and then beaten just 0.75l at Leopardstown (1m5f, good) last time; this shorter trip fine and she's a contender.
runners.comment: C&D winner off 4lb lower, last two runs encouraging, in the mix again

runners.name: Port Of Spain
runners.spotlight: Decent form last year included a Group 3 placing behind Derby winner Christmas Day; form has gone the wrong way so far this year, though it wasn't a terrible run at Galway on latest (1m4f, yld-sft); eased 1lb for that 5.25l defeat; needs more back in trip.
runners.comment: Eased 1lb for 5.75l defeat over 1m4f at Galway, needs more back in trip
runners.owner: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith

runners.name: Speckled Meadow
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner, most recently over C&D (yielding) last October; yet to hit top form this term and only midfield on latest at Galway; best form on much softer ground than this and 8lb wrong here.
runners.comment: C&D winner last year, yet to hit top form this season, best form on soft ground, 8lb wrong

races.race_name: Blackmore Building Contractors Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Stintino Sunset
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won for two years but regularly makes the frame; should not be far away but doesn't appeal for win purposes.
runners.comment: Hasn't won for two years but regularly makes the frame.

runners.name: Sea Of Charm
runners.spotlight: Back to form in refitted cheekpieces lately and has been placed on her last three starts; should be thereabouts once again.
runners.comment: Back to form in refitted cheekpieces lately and has been placed on her last three starts.

runners.name: Highland Harvey
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark when landing a classified at Yarmouth (11.5f, good to firm) last month; third when favourite back in handicaps at Yarmouth and Windsor this month and should give another good account.
runners.comment: Third when favourite in handicaps at Yarmouth and Windsor this month.

runners.name: The Pug
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been for previous trainers; hasn't yet gone forward from his opening third at Chepstow (1m2f, good to soft) in June for this yard.
runners.comment: Hasn't yet gone forward from his opening third at Chepstow in June for this yard.

runners.name: Little She
runners.spotlight: Has made the frame on several occasions but remains a 19-race maiden; her mark continues to fall and she should find one of these soon.
runners.comment: Has made the frame on several occasions but remains a 19-race maiden.

runners.name: Wrist Art
runners.spotlight: Both wins came when trained in Ireland in 2023; has made the frame in five of his last six races; returning cheekpieces replace visor but losing run is mounting up.
runners.comment: Has made the frame in five of his last six races.

races.race_name: blackmorebuild.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Tree Wizard
runners.spotlight: Beaten in a seller and a claimer on his second and third runs for Archie Watson; much better form when second of 13 in a maiden at Windsor (5f, good to firm) ten weeks ago when tried in blinkers for the first time; sold for 14,000gns last month; cheekpieces the headgear of choice on stable debut; leading form claims and could provide his apprentice, who has enjoyed some success in Qatar, with a first British win at the first attempt.
runners.comment: Improved for blinkers when 2nd at Windsor in June; sold 14,000gns since; cheekpieces today
runners.owner: Rashid Faleh S T Alhajri Alhajri

runners.name: Tricky Jenny
runners.spotlight: Went desperately close at Bath (5f, firm) last month but she failed to back it up when fourth returned to Bath 23 days ago; still has more to recommend her than most.
runners.comment: Beaten a nose at Bath (5f) last month; less good two weeks later but still a key player

runners.name: Last Dandelion
runners.spotlight: She was finishing placed for the second time from seven starts when third at Lingfield (5f, AW) on Thursday; best turf run came on firm ground so the recent rain perhaps not ideal.
runners.comment: Two placed efforts have been on AW, the latest on Thursday; best turf run on firm ground

runners.name: Space Dreamer
runners.spotlight: She hasn't seen things out in a couple of 5f events this summer; still capable of better and Billy Loughnane's presence in the saddle suggests improvement could be forthcoming.
runners.comment: Not seen things out in two 5f runs this summer; Billy Loughnane booked; can do better

runners.name: Cruse On Bye
runners.spotlight: Second run was better than his debut but he still finished last of the five runners; minor nurseries more suitable.
runners.comment: Second run was better than his debut but he still finished last of the five runners

runners.name: Water Angel
runners.spotlight: 50-1 when finishing down the field at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) 17 days ago; this is weaker but he will need a big step forward to win.
runners.comment: 50-1 when down the field at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) 17 days ago; this is weaker
runners.owner: Hold My Beer, M Broughton & T Elphick

races.race_name: John Heal Memorial Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Crowned
runners.spotlight: Clear promise in his three starts, albeit he could only manage fifth when the 2-1 favourite for a 6f Kempton nursery 18 days ago; that doesn't tell the whole story though as he was messed about at the start, poorly positioned as a result and then ran the fastest sectionals for the third, fourth and fifth furlongs before his effort petered out close home; capable of better.
runners.comment: Big mid-race move from a poor position on nursery debut; highly likely he's well treated

runners.name: Pageant Girl
runners.spotlight: 6f win at Ripon in April; poor runs on last four starts, tailed off when 150-1 for the Kempton nursery in which Crowned finished fifth 18 days ago; handicap mark in freefall but has a point to prove.
runners.comment: 6f win in April but struggled in four runs since; down in weights but with plenty to prove

runners.name: Priscilla's Hope
runners.spotlight: Little solid form in six starts; the addition of blinkers is not enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Little solid form in six starts; the addition of blinkers is not enough to tempt

runners.name: Dreams Galore
runners.spotlight: 2-2 since switched to nurseries, both wins coming in Class 6 events at Chepstow (5f-6f, good to firm); latest 7lb rise asks a stiffer question but she could still have more in the tank.
runners.comment: 2-2 since switched to nurseries; up 7lb but could well have more in the tank

runners.name: Cydney Sweenie
runners.spotlight: She hasn't progressed from her promising debut but it was a stronger nursery in which she finished fifth at Yarmouth (5f, good to firm) last month; down 2lb and could yet fare better.
runners.comment: Not progressed from an encouraging debut; drops into a Class 6; still has time on her side

runners.name: Harry's Pop
runners.spotlight: Appreciated the drop to Class 6 company when making all in a 6f nursery at Catterick (good ground) on Monday; there was plenty of money for him ahead of that success and he should give it a good go under a 6lb penalty.
runners.comment: Improved for the drop to Class 6 at Catterick (6f, good) on Monday, making all; contender
runners.owner: K Shenton, N Bradley 6 & D Cunha

races.race_name: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)

runners.name: Big Time Rascal
runners.spotlight: C&D wins in two of his last three starts, the latest his stable debut 16 days ago when he wore a tongue-tie for the first time; a 3lb rise shouldn't prevent another big run.
runners.comment: Won C&D events in two of last three starts; 3lb rise for latest success not insurmountable

runners.name: Twirler
runners.spotlight: Only midfield in this race 12 months ago when rated 3lb lower; she found only an unexposed 3yo too strong at Epsom 24 days ago and holds each-way claims again.
runners.comment: Only 6th in this race last year when rated 3lb lower; good 2nd latest; each-way shout

runners.name: Kento
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; three wins this year, including here, but put in his place by Secret Handsheikh 18 days ago; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Three wins this year but in Class 6 company; others hold stronger claims

runners.name: Bated Breeze
runners.spotlight: Won a classified event over C&D last month; only fourth back in handicap company 16 days ago and this demands more.
runners.comment: C&D win last month came in a 0-50 classified event; only fourth back in a handicap latest

runners.name: Dion Baker
runners.spotlight: The winner of five races this summer, latterly getting the better of Prefer The Sister over 7f here last month (6lb better off with that rival today); well drawn to attack but could help set this up for a finisher.
runners.comment: 5 wins in 2026 and ran well for 2nd here 17 days ago (off this mark); well drawn to attack

runners.name: Prefer The Sister
runners.spotlight: Another seemingly exposed sort to be galvanised by a move to James Owen, winning fast-ground handicaps here (7f), Yarmouth (1m) and Newmarket (7f); beaten favourite at Chepstow last time when running off a 9lb lower mark than today's; drops back to 6f with her hood discarded.
runners.comment: Had a busy midsummer, winning three and runner-up on three other occasions; up in weights

runners.name: Washington Heir
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in a 0-50 classified event here in June and he has run well in defeat here twice since; still improving and that doesn't apply to too many in this field.
runners.comment: On the up at this track this summer; could have more to offer; contender

runners.name: Diomed Spirit
runners.spotlight: Not been with Chris Gordon for long and he has run two good races for the yard, finishing second at Windsor before getting the better of Washington Heir over 5.3f here 16 days ago; whether he can prove quite so effective over 6f remains to be seen.
runners.comment: Game effort over 5.3f here 16 days ago; still to prove himself over 6f

runners.name: Giant
runners.spotlight: On a good mark and this is weaker than the races he has contested on his last three starts; a well-run 6f shouldn't be a problem and he is a key player despite his wide stall.
runners.comment: On a good mark and this is weaker than the races he has been contesting; should go well

runners.name: Port Hedland
runners.spotlight: Doesn't find winning easy and he has been well short of his best on his last three starts; others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Infrequent winner and short of his best on last three starts; easy enough to swerve

runners.name: My Boy Jack
runners.spotlight: Poor strike-rate, including 0-26 on turf; unlikely to be righting that wrong from 5lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: 0-26 on turf and likely vulnerable from 5lb out of the weights

runners.name: Candy Warhol
runners.spotlight: Front-runner; knocking at the door on turf this summer but he's 0-14 on the grass and he's unlikely to get his own way up front in this field.
runners.comment: 0-14 on turf; in good form but it won't be easy trying to dominate this field
runners.owner: Homecroft Wealth, Paul J Dixon & Partners

runners.name: Neptune Legend
runners.spotlight: Three turf wins (fast ground) since rejoining Tony Carroll, one of them coming over C&D; up in the weights as a result and the recent rain will suit others more.
runners.comment: Three turf wins since rejoining Tony Carroll, including C&D; recent rain not ideal

runners.name: Secret Handsheikh
runners.spotlight: Multiple course winner, the latest 18 days ago when he was far too strong for five rivals over 5.3f (good to firm); up 6lb in a deeper race but still feasibly weighted.
runners.comment: Multiple course winner, the latest an easy success in a 5.3f Class 6; one to consider

runners.name: Daley T
runners.spotlight: 27-race maiden; close third here in June came in a 0-50 classified event; easy enough to swerve.
runners.comment: Exposed maiden who is easy enough to swerve from out of the handicap

runners.name: Arnaz
runners.spotlight: Had been expensive to follow but he ended a losing run at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago when more positive tactics were deployed; unpenalised when bolting up back at Chepstow on Tuesday and he is effectively 11lb higher today; slower ground shouldn't be an issue but this will require a good deal more.
runners.comment: Two easy Chepstow wins this month; 11lb higher mark could find him out

races.race_name: Blackmore Design & Build Handicap

runners.name: Knights Gold
runners.spotlight: Last year's heroics were always going to be a tough act to follow but the addition of cheekpieces, allied to a reduced mark, have seen an upturn in his fortunes since June; latest Windsor second (1m, good to firm; stable debut) wasn't far off his best and he's high on the list with Billy Loughnane aboard for the first time.
runners.comment: Good second on recent stable debut; big run on the cards with Billy Loughnane booked

runners.name: North View
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won the races one of his ability should; 4lb lower than for his winning start for Stuart Williams in January (7f, AW) but that wasn't a springboard to better things; sold for 8,500gns this month; goes without headgear on first run for Tony Carroll; not sure what to expect.
runners.comment: Not won as many as he should but starts out for Tony Carroll on a dangerous mark

runners.name: Sea Suite
runners.spotlight: Three wins for James Owen this year, the latest over 1m here (good to firm) 18 days ago; a 2lb rise shouldn't prevent another prominent showing.
runners.comment: Three wins for James Owen this year, the latest here (1m) 18 days ago; contender once more

runners.name: Foreseen
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; in better forrm than his figures might suggest and he is only 2lb higher than when dominating a Class 3, albeit a weak one, at Lingfield in May; one of two runners for Tony Carroll.
runners.comment: Last two runs haven't been as bad as the distance beaten might suggest; stable run two

runners.name: King Of War
runners.spotlight: Four C&D wins to his name, the latest in June off 4lb lower; an easy lead would seem unlikely and this opposition may prove too demanding.
runners.comment: Multiple C&D winner at a lower level; easy lead seems unlikely today

runners.name: Cuban Lady
runners.spotlight: 6f maiden win last summer; up and down in handicaps since, running her best race of this campaign when third at Nottingham (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces first time) in June; sold for 14,000gns last month; headgear discarded and quickly stepped up in trip.
runners.comment: Raced only at sprint trips for Tom Clover; dangerous mark if new trip prompts improvement

runners.name: Dapper Guest
runners.spotlight: Won three 7f handicaps last season; generally underperformed in 2026 but his Newmarket fourth in June came off a 4lb higher mark; change of headgear today.
runners.comment: Three 7f wins last year; generally underperformed this year; change of headgear today

races.race_name: Blackmore Proudly Sponsoring Brighton Racecourse Handicap

runners.name: My Old Mate
runners.spotlight: Always prominent when winning a pair of handicaps at Windsor (1m, good to firm); came up short in his hat-trick bid at Lingfield (1m, AW) on Tuesday but Billy Loughnane replaces a 7lb claimer and there could still be further progress in him.
runners.comment: Came up short in hat-trick bid on Tuesday (1m, AW); Billy Loughnane back on board today

runners.name: Danehill Star
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; won twice on AW earlier in the year and he has run some good races on turf this summer; latest C&D run was disappointing but he's the type to bounce back quickly.
runners.comment: Disappointing over C&D last time but he is the type to bounce back quickly

runners.name: Marsh Benham
runners.spotlight: Ran well for second over C&D on his seasonal return in June and went one better at Sandown (1m, good to firm) 31 days ago; found little off the bridle when well beaten at Salisbury on Friday; would have a point to prove if turned out quickly.
runners.comment: Began 2026 with two good runs, including C&D, but ran poorly at Salisbury on Friday

runners.name: Nordic Norm
runners.spotlight: Beaten 12 times since his winning debut (for Karl Burke); went close at Chelmsford in March but two runs since have been underwhelming; tongue-tie now reached for.
runners.comment: Near miss on AW in March but two lacklustre runs have followed; now tongue tied

runners.name: War Chant
runners.spotlight: Should be well handicapped but his two runs for his current stable have resulted in heavy defeats; cheekpieces tried for a second time (well beaten on the occasion they were tried).
runners.comment: Two heavy defeats for current stable; return of cheekpieces not sure to be beneficial

races.race_name: Neu-Servo Bet On Great Repairs Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Gaelic Rambler
runners.spotlight: Latest race was voided just after halfway; still has low mileage and the time before he was third of eight in a 2m4f handicap at Uttoxeter, beaten 11l; now 0-6 over fences and he does look a tad high in the weights.
runners.comment: Now 0-6 over fences and he does look a tad high in the weights

runners.name: Gata Ban
runners.spotlight: At the eighth attempt she comfortably opened her account as a chaser over C&D in early June and then defied a penalty at Fontwell (3m2f, good), though that was harder work in a four-runner race; 3lb higher this time but unlikely to be far away.
runners.comment: 3lb higher than for hard-fought latest win but unlikely to be far away

runners.name: Camino Rocio
runners.spotlight: Won five handicap chases during 2024/2025, the latest off this mark; unable to win any small-field points this year but was bought for £10,000 in May and has joined Dan Skelton; has to be of interest after a wind operation, all the more so if strong in the betting.
runners.comment: Capable chaser off this mark in 2025; had wind op prior to debut for Dan Skelton

runners.name: Ras Kassar
runners.spotlight: Regular winner in France; continues to hold his own for current connections and gave well-handicapped opposition something to think about in his last two races (2m4f, good); won over 2m5f in France but hasn't ventured any further; definite chance if getting home.
runners.comment: Gave well-handicapped opposition something to think about in his last two races (2m4f)

runners.name: Axel Bleue
runners.spotlight: Remote third to Gata Ban here in June when in this headgear combination for the first time (retained since) but he won narrowly on his return visit and nearly followed up a month ago; 4lb higher than for that defeat but this lightly raced gelding has since had a wind operation.
runners.comment: Running well over C&D this summer and still lightly raced; had a wind operation

runners.name: All Inn Hand
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back wins in 2025 in a 2m6f novice hurdle (good) and 3m handicap chase (good to soft) but below that level since returning from a break (hurdling for last two races) and has a bit to prove at present.
runners.comment: Hurdle/chase winner in 2025 but below par since back from a break

runners.name: Twist Of Fatecatch
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on the best of his hurdle form (1-12) but that's for a reason and this is his chase debut; others safer.
runners.comment: Has become well handicapped for a reason and this is his chase debut

runners.name: Billy Boi Blue
runners.spotlight: Faced tough tasks in his first two chases (latest in November 2025) and returns to this discipline after winning narrowly over hurdles off this figure a month ago (2m7f, good); clearly on a workable mark if he can click over fences.
runners.comment: 0-2 over fences but tough tasks; won off this mark over hurdles a month ago

races.race_name: Neu-Servo Rapid Response Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: At The Oche
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner and competitive in handicaps for his previous yard, which he left for £22,000 and then underwent wind surgery; built for fences so no great surprise to see him justify favouritism at Uttoxter four weeks ago (2m4f, good); beat an in-form horse and would have done so more easily but for one notable mistake; big chance despite being raised 9lb.
runners.comment: Survived one notable mistake for his successful chase/stable debut at Uttoxeter

runners.name: Imperial Bede
runners.spotlight: Capable chaser on his day having won two of his 16 races in this discipline but he's very up and down; others are safer.
runners.comment: Capable chaser having won two of his 16 races in this discipline but he's very up and down

runners.name: Pep Talking
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who was granted an easy lead last time at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) and made no mistake by 3l; hard to grumble with the 3lb rise and if getting into a rhythm he should put up another bold show.
runners.comment: Front-runner who was granted an easy lead last time at Uttoxeter and won by 3l; up 3lb

runners.name: Little Ledgend
runners.spotlight: Beaten nine times over hurdles but runner-up in four of those, including last time here over 2m4f in this new headgear combination; 5lb rise sees him on a career-high mark but he should make a chaser.
runners.comment: Beaten nine times over hurdles but runner-up in four of those; should make a chaser

runners.name: Court In A Storm
runners.spotlight: Bumper and dual hurdle winner; second to a Skelton horse on his chase debut and last run here over 2m7f wasn't too bad as the front-runners never came back; each-way claims.
runners.comment: Last run here over 2m7f wasn't too bad as front-runners never came back; each-way claims

runners.name: Coastguard Station
runners.spotlight: Fairly treated and some fair efforts at 2m4f/2m5f before struggling back over 2m in a Class 2; that's readily forgiven and he'll probably run well.
runners.comment: Some fair efforts at 2m4f/2m5f before struggling back over 2m in a Class 2

runners.name: Hudson
runners.spotlight: 0-8 over hurdles and 0-3 as a chaser; well behind At The Oche at Uttoxeter last time when the new cheekpieces made little difference.
runners.comment: Behind At The Oche at Uttoxeter last time when the new cheekpieces made little difference
runners.owner: Miss Jayne Brace & Mrs Karen Smith

runners.name: Homme Public
runners.spotlight: Third over fences at Bangor on May reappearance (2m1f, good) but that mini revival was still well short of his peak efforts in 2025 and he ran no race back over hurdles at Cartmel (2m6f); unconvincing.
runners.comment: Some sign of a revival at Bangor in May but had a shocker back hurdling last time

runners.name: Mix Of Clover
runners.spotlight: He was off his last winning mark when always prominent and doing it readily over C&D last time; should be a factor off 6lb higher.
runners.comment: Off his last winning mark when always prominent and doing it readily over C&D last time

runners.name: Doyouknowwhatimean
runners.spotlight: All four chase wins came around 2m when trained by Dan Skelton; ran well on yard debut in December but little to show for his eight subsequent runs; has dropped to a dangerous mark, however.
runners.comment: Has dropped to a dangerous mark but opposable on his last eight efforts

races.race_name: Neu-Servo Neigh Bad Repairs Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Thetype Istitle
runners.spotlight: Got a soft lead when making all at Stratford but folded tamely next time at Uttoxeter; however, as a past winner and now ridden by Harry Cobden, she has to be respected.
runners.comment: Got a soft lead when making all at Stratford but folded tamely next time at Uttoxeter

runners.name: Delulu
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to winners Another Mystery (point and 2m5f-3m hurdle/chase), Percy De Courcy and Misstree Song (both points); dam point winner/placed 2m2f-3m hurdles; in the Skelton yard and she's a 4yo filly with her allowances.
runners.comment: In the Skelton yard and she's a 4yo filly with her allowances

runners.name: Turbogeist
runners.spotlight: Outpaced but kept on for second on good ground here three months ago and that was a likeable start; should feature.
runners.comment: Outpaced but kept on for second on good ground here three months ago

runners.name: Pedro's Moon
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam point and 2m3f hurdle/3m chase winner, out of unraced half-sister to 2m hurdle winner The Irregular, from family of top-class staying chaser Any Second Now; bred to have a future and no surprise should this newcomer have a part to play.
runners.comment: Bred to have a future and no surprise should this newcomer have a part to play

runners.name: Spanish Darling
runners.spotlight: Bought for £15,000 in May soon after winning a point bumper and a 2m4f point; tongue-tie fitted for rules debut; has some proven ability.
runners.comment: Bought for £15,000 in May soon after winning a point bumper and a 2m4f point

runners.name: I've Got A Friend
runners.spotlight: Unseated midrace in his first point and then a 6l runner-up in the second; likely best watched.
runners.comment: Unseated midrace in his first point and then a 6l runner-up in the second

runners.name: Treshnish Point
runners.spotlight: 20,000euros foal; third foal; dam maiden pointer, half-sister to winners Nom De Guerre (2m4f hurdle/3m1f chase) and Guts For Garters (3m-4m hurdle/chase); had wind surgery; stable has bumper winners and Brian Hughes is booked.
runners.comment: Dam well related; stable has bumper winners and Brian Hughes is booked

runners.name: Jaunty Trooper
runners.spotlight: Ninth foal from a prolific family; 40-1 at Uttoxeter where he bucked repeatedly and unseated rider soon after the start; moved yards but with the same owners.
runners.comment: 40-1 at Uttoxeter where he bucked repeatedly and unseated rider soon after the start

runners.name: Queens Glance
runners.spotlight: Beaten 16l here and then about 12l at Stratford when last of the seven; opposable.
runners.comment: Beaten 16l here and then about 12l at Stratford when last of the seven; opposable

runners.name: Esther Spring
runners.spotlight: Finished closer on second run at Southwell in May but was still about 10l off the winner; more needed.
runners.comment: Finished closer on second run at Southwell in May but was still about 10l off the winner

runners.name: Whin Cover
runners.spotlight: Well held in two Uttoxeter bumpers for Paul Collins; has since had wind surgery.
runners.comment: Well held in two Uttoxeter bumpers for Paul Collins; has since had wind surgery

races.race_name: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB)

runners.name: Down To Business
runners.spotlight: Fair maiden on the Flat for Andrew Oliver; has shown promise in this sphere for Dan Skelton, in the frame in juveniles at Newbury and Ascot before making late errors when fifth of eight in 2m Ludlow juvenile in February; has since undergone wind surgery and holds leading form claims.
runners.comment: Late errors when creditable Ludlow fifth in February; had wind op; leading form claims

runners.name: Whinney Hill
runners.spotlight: Useful bumper scorer but he failed to build on a promising start in this sphere for Gordon Elliott, pulled up in maiden hurdles on his last two runs early in 2026; changed hands for 4,000gns since and has plenty to prove for his new yard with a hood fitted.
runners.comment: Pulled up in maiden hurdles on his last two runs; plenty to prove for his new yard

runners.name: Thiscouldbetheone
runners.spotlight: Fair ex-Irish maiden hurdler who signed off for Martin Brassil with good third of 13 in 2m6f Tramore maiden in May; not ruled out for his new yard after a break.
runners.comment: Good third at Tramore in May; not ruled out for his new yard after a break

runners.name: Network Gold
runners.spotlight: Dartmouth gelding; fair form shown when placed in a pair of juvenile hurdles in December, sticking to his task well when runner-up at Lingfield (2m) on latter occasion; likely capable of better and not out of things on his seasonal return.
runners.comment: Placed in a pair of juvenile hurdles in December; not out of things on seasonal return

runners.name: Giant's Way
runners.spotlight: Fifth in bumper here on his debut in June but again tongue tied when a well-held ninth in C&D novice on his hurdling debut the following month; this son of Walk In The Park fetched 140,000euros as a 3yo and could still do better.
runners.comment: Well-held ninth in C&D novice on his hurdling debut; could still do better

runners.name: Baltic
runners.spotlight: A fairly useful 1m4f Flat winner for Harry Charlton in 2024; not so good in that sphere for his current yard and came in last of six in 1m6f Newmarket handicap 15 days ago; hurdle debut.
runners.comment: Winner on Flat but last of six in 1m6f Newmarket handicap 15 days ago; hurdle debut

runners.name: Savanna Storm
runners.spotlight: Built on debut seventh with fourth of nine in 2m1f bumper at Newton Abbot last month; no forlorn hope now going hurdling.
runners.comment: Fourth in 2m1f bumper at Newton Abbot last month; no forlorn hope now going hurdling

runners.name: Lucky Diamond
runners.spotlight: Placed in a bumper here last October; yet to offer much in a pair of maiden hurdles over C&D this summer.
runners.comment: Placed in a bumper but yet to offer much in a pair of maiden hurdles over C&D this summer

runners.name: Fervent
runners.spotlight: A dual winner (at up to 1m4f) on the Flat in Ireland for Stuart Crawford last June; changed hands for 58,000gns and showed promise on his yard/hurdling debut in 2m Southwell maiden in May, still in third when falling last; open to progress.
runners.comment: Promise on yard/hurdling debut at Southwell, in third when fell last; open to progress

runners.name: Happy Chandler
runners.spotlight: A modest 1m2f Flat scorer in April; 40-1, hinted at promise with fifth of nine in novice over C&D on hurdling debut last month; can build on it here.
runners.comment: Hinted at promise with C&D fifth on hurdling debut last month; can build on it here

runners.name: Snow Is In The Sky
runners.spotlight: A winning Irish pointer but she's offered little in a pair of maiden hurdles at Southwell (2m) and Chepstow (19.5f) in March; significantly more is required.
runners.comment: Offered little in a pair of maiden hurdles at Southwell and Chepstow; more is required

runners.name: Annual Invitation
runners.spotlight: Placed in a pair of Irish points; brought along steadily over hurdles, catching the eye under a considerate ride when fifth of seven in 2m Uttoxeter novice in May; hood goes on; capable of better after a break.
runners.comment: Caught eye under a considerate ride when fifth at Uttoxeter in May; capable of better

races.race_name: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Ocean Heights
runners.spotlight: A fair 1m4f Flat winner last May; yet to score in this sphere but comes here on the back of a good second of eight to Cawthorne Banker in 2m Uttoxeter handicap 30 days ago; enjoys a 4lb weights pull here so very much one to consider.
runners.comment: Good second at Uttoxeter latest; very much one to consider in bid for first hurdling win

runners.name: Genbu
runners.spotlight: Back to winning ways in 2m Uttoxeter handicap in May and largely in good form since over hurdles; made mistakes when last of eight on his chasing debut at Market Rasen (2m1f) eight days ago and not discounted quickly returned to this sphere.
runners.comment: In good form over hurdles; last on chasing debut at Market Rasen latest; not discounted

runners.name: Cawthorne Banker
runners.spotlight: Has proved unreliable but he resumed winning ways at Uttoxeter (2m) in July and followed up with another 2m handicap win there 30 days ago, overhauling Ocean Heights late on; not taken lightly in his current mood.
runners.comment: Has proved unreliable but on hat-trick after pair of Uttoxeter wins; not taken lightly

runners.name: Raffles Nobu
runners.spotlight: Ex-French winner who capitalised on a reduced mark when gaining a first success for current yard at Newton Abbot (2m2f) in July; backed it up with a solid third (off a 7lb higher mark) in 2m1f Cartmel handicap since; can make his presence felt eased 1lb.
runners.comment: Won at Newton Abbot; solid third at Cartmel since; can make his presence felt eased 1lb

runners.name: Castle Quarter
runners.spotlight: A four-time Flat winner (at up to 1m2f); gained a first hurdling win at Uttoxeter (2m) last May and back on track with third of eight to Cawthorne Banker at Uttoxeter (2m) last time; needs to reproduce it here.
runners.comment: Back on track with third at Uttoxeter (2m) last time; needs to reproduce it here
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs R Newiss & Gavin Teversham

runners.name: Kernie d'Airy
runners.spotlight: A fairly useful ex-French bumper winner; got off the mark for current yard in maiden over C&D in June and not discredited when fifth on her handicap debut in steadily-run contest over C&D last time; she could still do better granted a likely stiffer test of stamina here.
runners.comment: C&D winner; not discredited when fifth over C&D latest; could still do better

runners.name: Crown Of India
runners.spotlight: Bagged a second C&D success in May and has posted good efforts when runner-up over C&D and at Market Rasen (2m) since; up 2lb but he enters calculations once more.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner; good Market Rasen second latest; up 2lb but enters calculations again

runners.name: Network Rgb
runners.spotlight: Brought along steadily last season; off seven months and failed to progress on his handicap debut with eighth of ten to Cawthorne Banker at Uttoxeter (2m) last month; this son of Telescope could still do better though for good yard.
runners.comment: Failed to progress on handicap debut with eighth at Uttoxeter; could still do better

runners.name: Zafaan
runners.spotlight: Pulled up when last seen over hurdles at Uttoxeter (2m) in May but has won on the Flat since at Yarmouth; not out of things if back on his A-game.
runners.comment: Pulled up when last seen over hurdles at Uttoxeter in May but has won on the Flat since

runners.name: Ez Tiger
runners.spotlight: A dual hurdles winner (including over C&D) last season; shaped well on his return when runner-up over C&D in June but failed to beat a rival back here last time; the sort to bounce back though.
runners.comment: Runner-up over C&D but failed to beat a rival here last time; the sort to bounce back

runners.name: Graecia
runners.spotlight: Free-going sort who gained a first success in this sphere over C&D in September but she ended the season below par; freshened up since and no surprise to see her get back on track after a layoff.
runners.comment: C&D winner; ended last season below par but no surprise to see her get back on track

runners.name: Connemara Joe
runners.spotlight: Only modest form shown in his three runs to date, coming in a never-dangerous fifth of seven in C&D novice last month; cheekpieces go on for his handicap debut with more required.
runners.comment: Only modest form shown in his three runs to date; cheekpieces on for his handicap debut

runners.name: Mojo Ego
runners.spotlight: Made a winning start for Fergal O'Brien over C&D (form been franked) in July and shaped as if still in good form when sixth of 12 over 2m4f at Market Rasen since, fading from two out; interesting back at 2m.
runners.comment: C&D winner (form franked); faded from 2 out at Market Rasen since; interesting back at 2m

races.race_name: Neu-Servo Best Repairs Hands Down Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Harry
runners.spotlight: Had a very eye-catching piece of form in 2023 when based in France; back from a mammoth absence this summer and he made all for wins at Dieppe and Clairefontaine (2m3f+); has left Noel George & Amanda Zetterholm; seems to enjoy soft/heavy ground, which is a concern.
runners.comment: Some notable efforts in France but a worry that he seems to like testing ground

runners.name: Trouville
runners.spotlight: Useful Flat performer for the Crisfords; has made a solid start over hurdles, winning over 2m here and then fourth when penalised at Uttoxeter; should have a future off this sort of mark.
runners.comment: Useful on Flat; maiden winner here and should have a future off this sort of mark

runners.name: County Champs
runners.spotlight: 0-14 over hurdles in Ireland but ran well in some big fields last year; campaigned mainly at about 3m but interesting to see what Chris Gordon can do with him; changed hands for £9,500; market could be informative.
runners.comment: 0-14 in Ireland but ran well in some big fields; respected on debut for Chris Gordon
runners.owner: The Les & Jan Gilbert Racing Legacy

runners.name: Letterston Lily
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism at Perth in April (2m4f, good) on return from a long absence but fared nothing like so well at Market Rasen a month ago; she's consistent in the main and could bounce back; 5lb higher than for that recent win; non-runner at Newton Abbot yesterday.
runners.comment: Perth winner after long absence; better than she showed last time; non-runner yesterday

runners.name: Norman Fletcher
runners.spotlight: Ran okay in the new visor last time at Cartmel but ran better the time before in a Class 4 at Newton Abbot and he's now back in that grade; Sam Twiston-Davies takes over from a claimer.
runners.comment: Runner-up in a Class 4 two starts back; Sam Twiston-Davies takes over from a claimer

runners.name: Dream Diamond
runners.spotlight: Won a 2m maiden here last August (good) and has been threatening in handicaps, including at this trip; doesn't appear to have much up his sleeve off this mark but has each-way credentials.
runners.comment: Won a 2m maiden here last August (good) and has been threatening in handicaps

runners.name: Romany Brown
runners.spotlight: Irish maiden hurdle winner; five runs for this yard, the best last time at Uttoxeter when about 12l off the winner; could improve on that.
runners.comment: Won a 2m maiden here last August (good) and has been threatening in handicaps
runners.owner: Case Racing Partnership & Anita J Lush

runners.name: Tintintin
runners.spotlight: Close fourth in the Imperial Cup at Sandown (2m, good to soft) in March 2025 and very well handicapped on that form; not shown much in just four subsequent runs but couldn't discount.
runners.comment: Wellbeing issues but he's well handicapped on his Imperial Cup fourth (March 2025)

races.race_name: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Forest Spirit
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner; yet to win over hurdles but went close at Ffos Las in May (2m4f, good to soft; first-time cheekpieces); that run hasn't proved a springboard to anything better.
runners.comment: 2nd at Ffos Las in May but that run hasn't proved a springboard to anything better

runners.name: Klervia
runners.spotlight: 0-12 under rules; poor final run for Fergal O'Brien and produced another when last to finish on yard debut at Stratford.
runners.comment: Poor final run for Fergal O'Brien and produced another when last to finish on yard debut

runners.name: Diamond White
runners.spotlight: Second to earlier-race contender Trouville before beaten a neck in a maiden at Newton Abbot, a race she would have won but for jumping out to the right and hitting the last hurdle; could be still be learning after only six races; probably on a fair mark for this first handicap.
runners.comment: Inexperience appeared to cost her a maiden win last time; handicap debut

runners.name: The Secret Pearl
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle in April 2025 and later runner-up in two handicaps; however, hard to warm to on this season's form.
runners.comment: Maiden winner with form in handicaps but hard to warm to after the season he's had

runners.name: Kylenoe Dancer
runners.spotlight: Fontwell winner last May (sole success; 2m3f, good) and two good runs this season, back there last time and at this venue the start before; solid chance.
runners.comment: Fontwell winner last May (sole success; 2m3f, good) and two good runs this season

runners.name: La Lolita
runners.spotlight: 2m5f novice winner in October; made handicap debut at Stratford last month (2m2f, good to firm) and ran as though that race was needed after a break of 252 days; better expected.
runners.comment: Novice winner; beaten 13l on handicap debut after a break; may have needed that

runners.name: Kottayam
runners.spotlight: Has lost her way since some initial promise and comfortably beaten in both her runs since moving yards; cheekpieces tried last time are removed.
runners.comment: Has lost her way since some initial promise; two quiet runs since moving yards

runners.name: Joto
runners.spotlight: Yet to win over hurdles but has three thirds to her name this year (2m1f-2m3f) and luck has deserted her in last two races, unseating early in March and then tack issues a factor in May; may prefer softer ground but one to consider.
runners.comment: Yet to win over hurdles but three thirds to her name this year; luckless last two races

runners.name: Lady Harriett
runners.spotlight: Only 1-19 over hurdles and last four runs were forgettable; however, she's back from a break with Sean Bowen riding off a feather weight.
runners.comment: She's back from a break with Sean Bowen riding off a feather weight

runners.name: Blue Siam
runners.spotlight: Maiden on Flat and over hurdles (0-5); ran poorly on the Flat last time (second-time visor) but very effective in cheekpieces and she has the form to feature off this mark.
runners.comment: Maiden both codes; has the form to feature and cheekpieces are back on

runners.name: Mya Du Clos
runners.spotlight: Hasn't had a lot of racing and was a close second over this trip at Uttoxeter in June despite market weakness; turn looks near.
runners.comment: Close second over this trip at Uttoxeter in June despite market weakness

runners.name: Medina Blue
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced ex-Irish mare; no closer than 11l in four races in Britain, the latest her handicap debut over C&D (12-1).
runners.comment: No closer than 11l in four races in Britain, the latest her handicap debut over C&D (12-1)

runners.name: Mrs Biddle
runners.spotlight: 9-1 when due to reappear from an absence here on Wednesday only to get loose before the start; 0-15 over hurdles and inconsistent in Ireland, but she ran the odd decent race there; not dismissed.
runners.comment: Maiden in Ireland but ran the odd decent race there; 9-1 when withdrawn here on Wednesday

runners.name: Saratoga Special
runners.owner: Abbondanza Racing LLC & TCC Stables LLC

runners.name: Mescalero
runners.owner: Perry R Bass II & Ramona S Bass

runners.name: Incanto
runners.owner: David A Bernsen LLC, TCC Stables LLC & Jeffrey Lambert

runners.name: Sorrento Sky
runners.owner: Benowitz Family Trust, CYBT Et Al

runners.name: No Nay Hudson
runners.owner: Andrew Farm, For The People Racing Stable & Debra L O'Connor

runners.name: Sumter
runners.owner: Perry R Bass II & Ramona S Bass

runners.name: Kensington Lane
runners.spotlight: Won the Belmont Oaks by just under 2l at Saratoga last month; has earned plenty of prize money overseas, on target two from nine starts; is respected.
runners.comment: Must go on the shortlist; on top in Belmont Oaks last month.
runners.owner: Agave Racing Stable, Medallion Racing & Evan Trommer

runners.name: Green Carrera
runners.spotlight: On target three times in seven runs overseas, earning decent prize-money; one to watch in the market making debut on these shores.
runners.comment: Be led by the betting on this first start on these shores.

runners.name: Victorious Dream
