runners.spotlight: Won by just over 2l five weeks ago in an allowance optional claimer; attempts to land a hat-trick; looks likely to go well.
runners.comment: Can be in the thick of things; emerged on top five weeks ago.
runners.owner: Eclipse Thoroughbred Partners, Sabby Racing & Michael House

runners.name: Tam Tam
runners.spotlight: On target three times in her last five outings; proved competitive when hitting the board in a Grade 2 four months ago; useful performance to win at Churchill Downs by 6l in an allowance listed two months ago; strong contender.
runners.comment: She's a serious player; scored by 6l two months ago.

runners.name: Inbox
runners.spotlight: Good effort when close up over 1m here (handicap Grade 2) with three of these rivals behind her last month; shouldn't be too far away.
runners.comment: Is not ruled out; in front of several of these last month.
runners.owner: Hopeless Stables, Little Red Feather Racing Et Al

runners.name: Wild Like The West
runners.spotlight: Finished behind three of these rivals five weeks ago when beaten 5l in a handicap Grade 2; possible blip last time out as had been running well previously; not hard to turn elsewhere as this looks a fair heat.
runners.comment: Facing a testing assignment and there are better alternatives here.

runners.name: Define
runners.spotlight: Opened account at the fourth time of asking when in front by just under 3l (Ellis Park) last month in a maiden special weight; winless in three starts overseas; despite that Ellis Park success, looks risky.
runners.comment: Despite that Ellis Park success, others make more appeal.

runners.name: Peanutbutterbombe
runners.spotlight: Successful twice in her last five starts; split a number of these rivals when fourth beaten just over 2l last month in a handicap Grade 2; now tried over a longer trip.
runners.comment: Split a number of these rivals five weeks ago; managed two wins in her last five outings.
runners.owner: Little Red Feather Racing & William Strauss

runners.name: Raiding Party
runners.spotlight: Split a number of these rivals last month when third (sent off 13-8) in a handicap Grade 2; winner of two of her four career runs; covers an extra 1f here.
runners.comment: Split a number of these rivals 35 days ago; winner of two of her four runs to date.
runners.owner: Larry R Rodgers, James J Lamonica Et Al

runners.name: Lookin At Diamond
runners.spotlight: Related to Stakes winner Diamond Wow; split Inbox and Wild Like The West when third in June at Santa Anita in an allowance listed.
runners.comment: Solid effort to finish third in June; wins-runs record of 1-3.

runners.name: Om N Joy
runners.spotlight: Progressed into very useful filly in 2025, winning five times including Grade 3 Torry Pines Stakes here (1m; by half a length) in August; improved again last two starts, winning Grade 2 Santa Margarita at Santa Anita (9f; easily by 4l) in May before half-length second to Eunomia in Clement L. Hirsch Stakes here (8.5f) this month; tougher task against makes and has to prove stamina.
runners.comment: Grade 3 and Grade 2 winner and good second last time; has to prove stamina
runners.owner: Baker Stables LLC, Scanlan Racing LLC & Michael Golovko

runners.name: Knightsbridge
runners.spotlight: High-class horse, devastating in hat-trick of Grade 3 wins at Gulfstream last winter (all in very fast time); back to form when winning Grade 3 Monmouth Cup (1m1f) by just over 10l from Money Game; has lots of early pace but has to overcome wide draw, pace pressure and needs to prove stamina at 1m2f; highly respected but may start at cramped odds, considering difficulties.
runners.comment: Easy winner up to 1m1f of three Grade 3s in 2026; good chance, if getting the 1m2f trip

runners.name: Hit Show
runners.spotlight: Late-running stamina glutton who got the perfect set-up in 2025 Dubai World Cup at Meydan (1m2f); creditable efforts this term when placed in Grade 3 Blame at Churchill Downs (1m1f; travelled strongly, short of room, caught eye in third) and Grade 2 Suburban at Saratoga (did best of the closers, 10l second to impressive front-runner Phileas Fogg); could get perfect set-up here with so much early pace signed on and looks to be coming to the boil.
runners.comment: 2025 Dubai World Cup (10f) winner; good efforts over 1m1f last two; has perfect set-up

runners.name: Forged Steel
runners.spotlight: Hard-charging front-runner; got loose early in Grade 2 at Santa Anita in May (1m2f) and proceeded to register very smart effort in winning by nearly 10l from Malarchuk; nowhere near same level in the face of even mild pressure, including last time, and will not find this group accommodating.
runners.comment: May have been flattered when 9.5l winner of Grade 2 penultimate start (1m2f); passed over
runners.owner: C2 Racing Stable LLC, Mathis Stable LLC & TCC Stables LLC

runners.name: Navajo Warrior
runners.spotlight: In tremendous form, completing hat-trick in allowance at Gulfstream and Grade 3s at Pimlico (9.5f) and Prairie Meadows (9f); set strong pace and stayed on well to win by three and a half lengths from Bullard in Cornhusker Handicap on latter occasion; should give another good account but this is tougher.
runners.comment: Hat-trick scorer, including pair of Grade 3s; claims but may find it difficult to dominate
runners.owner: Bag Racing Stables, Miller Racing Et Al

runners.name: British Isles
runners.spotlight: Clearly best effort to win five-runner Grade 1 Santa Anita Handicap (1m2f) in March by 5l from Vodka Vodka; disappointing since in Grade 3 at Keeneland and Grade 2 Hollywood Gold Cup (1m2f), in latter 10l behind Forged Steel; hard to trust.
runners.comment: Best effort to win Grade 1 at Santa Anita (1m2f) at March; disappointing since and opposed
runners.owner: Slam Dunk Racing, Debby Baltas & Cynthia McClanahan

runners.name: Full Serrano
runners.spotlight: First home of the front-runners when third to Skippylongstocking in strongly run Grade 1 Pegasus World Cup at Gulfstream (1m1f) in January, then stumbled badly start when 3l fourth to Nu What's New in Grade 3 Oaklawn Mile in March; runner-up two years ago and looks to have been laid out (trainer has won this four times) but faces so much pressure up front.
runners.comment: Caught eye both times in 2026; second two years ago but may face too much pace pressure

runners.name: Original Sin
runners.spotlight: Curlin colt who won Grade 3 Blame Stakes at Churchill Downs (1m1f) in May; stiffer task when well-beaten ninth in Grade 2 Suburban Stakes at Saratoga (1m2f) last time (Forged Steel fifth); this is more difficult still.
runners.comment: Grade 3 winner; struggled in Grade 2 last time and now faces stiffer task; hard to fancy

runners.name: Finger
runners.spotlight: Japanese-trained colt by Gun Runner; won Listed Tokyo Derby at Ohi in June (1m2f, muddy) by about a length in 16-runner field (second-fastest time in race history); it's hard to be confident how he fits in terms of class but he is nicely drawn; promising young trainer saddled 2024 Breeders' Cup Turf runner-up Rousham Park.
runners.comment: Japanese-trained colt who won Listed Tokyo Derby (1m2f, muddy) in fast time; interesting

runners.name: Malarchuk
runners.spotlight: Useful form, lightly raced; runner-up at Santa Anita in 2026 in allowance race and Grade 2 Hollywood Gold Cup (1m2f), in latter beaten nearly 10l by Forged Steel after latter established a clear early lead; needs to step up a good deal to defeat these.
runners.comment: Second in allowance and Grade 2 this year, beaten 9.5l by Forged Steel in latter; opposed
runners.owner: ERJ Racing LLC & Reddam Racing LLC

runners.name: Subsanador
runners.spotlight: High-class horse at his best, winner of three Grade 1s, two in Argentina and California Crown Stakes at Santa Anita (1m1f) in September 2024; not the same force of old and tailed off in Grade 2 last time; opposed.
runners.comment: Three-time Grade 1 winner, latest in 2024; not the force of old and tailed off latest

races.race_name: Sumbe Prix du Calvados (Group 2) (Fillies) (Turf)

runners.name: Dee's Funny Girl
runners.spotlight: Won on debut at Thirsk (5f, good) in May for Michael Keady and then was beaten less than 6l as an 80-1 chance in the Group 3 Albany over C&D (good to firm); changed stables and improved again when runner-up in the Gp3 Princess Margaret (6f, good to firm) again at Ascot; should stay new trip.
runners.comment: Comes into this off a good effort in a Group 3 at Ascot

runners.name: Hinata Grey
runners.spotlight: Debut winner at Chantilly (6f, very soft) which she followed with two sound efforts in Group 3 company, both of over 6f, albeit one time behind Yuquot; more than enough on dam side of pedigree to suggest she'll stay 7f.
runners.comment: Run well in Group 3s over 6f and may do better over this distance

runners.name: Yuquot
runners.spotlight: Not added to her debut win yet but only run in Group 3s and Listed races since, mostly with plenty of credit without making much progress; should run her race but finished behind Woot Woot over C&D last time and doesn't have the scope some of her rivals have for improvement.
runners.comment: Consistent filly but not making lots of progress; others preferred

runners.name: Divina Fe
runners.spotlight: Maiden but run a couple of good races on the figures here, the first time over 6f then 7f (good to firm ground), but this looks a tough task ask.
runners.comment: Has run well but still a maiden taking on a field of winners; tough task
runners.owner: Scuderia Chiolo, Meridian International SAS et al

runners.name: Woot Woot
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far on debut at Saint-Cloud (7f, soft) and then won over same C&D on faster ground before a career best third over this C&D last time for the Group 3 Prix Six Perfections; no concerns about stamina and big chance.
runners.comment: Career best over this C&D last time, so no worries about stamina

runners.name: Le Bon Temps Roule
runners.spotlight: Supplemented for this; narrowly beaten on debut at Dieppe (5.5f, soft) before producing a far better effort on the figures when winning here over 6f earlier this month; step up in trip should be okay on pedigree.
runners.comment: Improved plenty of debut last time and represents a leading stable; can go well

races.race_name: Sumbe Prix Kergorlay (Group 2) (Turf)

runners.name: Santorini Star
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in the Prix de Royallieu at Longchamp (1m6f, very soft) on her final start last year and reappeared with a Group 2 success at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) in May; improved on that form when going close in the Prix Vicomtesse Vigier (1m7f, soft) next time and bounced back from a poor effort with a narrow defeat in the Lillie Langtry at Goodwood last time; leading contender.
runners.comment: Went close in the Prix Vicomtesse Vigier in May and at Goodwood last time; leading chance

runners.name: Double Major
runners.spotlight: Won this race in 2024 by 7l and held off Goya Senora by a short neck in this year's renewal; wasn't far off his best when sixth in the Prix Vicomtesse Vigier at Longchamp (1m7f, soft) in May but did have every chance when a close-up third in a Group 2 there last month (1m6f, good to firm); bids for a hat-trick of wins in this contest and he's respected.
runners.comment: Won this race last year and in 2024; held every chance when third in a Group 2 last time

runners.name: Defiantly
runners.spotlight: Progressive 4yo who went close in the Ascot Stakes (2m4f, good to firm) in June before going one better with a likeable staying performance in a Goodwood handicap (2m4f, good to firm) last month, not for catching after kicking for home a fair way out; the drop back in trip isn't an obvious positive on his first go in Group company but, supplemented for this and has to be respected.
runners.comment: Progressive 4yo; won a 2m4f handicap at Goodwood last time; has been supplemented

runners.name: Aeronef
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who won twice at Saint-Cloud over 1m4f in March/April (good to soft/soft), and progressed again when beaten a neck in a Listed event over this C&D this month on his first start for 113 days; this will require another step forward but he should still be capable of better after just five starts.
runners.comment: 3yo who won twice over 1m4f at Saint-Cloud and went close in a C&D Listed race last time

runners.name: Barbate
runners.spotlight: Improving stayer who has won six of his last eight starts, including a 1m7f Listed event at Saint-Cloud (good) in June; respectable fourth of six on his first go in Group 2 at Longchamp (1m6f, good to firm) last month (had Double Major ahead of him).
runners.comment: Has won six of his last eight starts; had Double Major ahead when fourth at Longchamp

runners.name: Goya Senora
runners.spotlight: Acts on most ground; 10yo who landed this race in 2022 and has finished runner-up to Double Major for the last two years; third of seven in a Listed event at Saint-Cloud (1m7f, good) in June and left the impression he's still in form at Clairefontaine last month; this hold-up performer has each-way claims.
runners.comment: Won this in 2022 and runner-up the last two years; this 10yo holds each-way claims
runners.owner: Alain Jathiere & Ecurie Haras Des Senora

races.race_name: Sumbe Prix Morny (Group 1) (Turf)

runners.name: Senorita Bonita
runners.spotlight: Quickened up well to make a winning debut at Nottingham (5f, good) in June; ran a big race when second of 27 in the Queen Mary (5f, good to firm) and appreciated the step up to this trip when landing the Duchess Of Cambridge Stakes at Newmarket last month; that form was well franked by Libertango in the Lowther on Thursday and this filly is a leading contender for a stable that won this with Vandeek in 2023.
runners.comment: Newmarket win was franked in the Lowther on Thursday; stable won this in 2023; contender

runners.name: Orthodox
runners.spotlight: Justified strong market confidence on his debut at Salisbury (5f, good) in May and backed that up with an impressive performance in the Norfolk (5f, good to firm), a race his trainer won with Reckless Abandon in 2012 before landing this contest; he's been off since having suffered a small setback but looks sure to have no problem with the step up to 6f; an exciting prospect; strong claims.
runners.comment: Made it 2-2 when impressing in the Norfolk; should have no problem with 6f; strong claims

runners.name: Man's Best Friend
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when winning an 18-runner maiden at Naas (6f, good) last month and overcame trouble in-running to land the Richmond Stakes (6f, good to firm) at Goodwood eight days later; he's progressed with each start and is the choice of Ryan Moore; strong claims.
runners.comment: Overcame trouble to land the Richmond Stakes at Goodwood last month; holds strong claims
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Kosuma
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten filly, winning twice at Saint-Cloud (6f; good/good to soft) in May before making it 3-3 with a stylish performance in a Group 3 over this C&D last time (good); this well-bred filly is an exciting prospect and makes the shortlist.
runners.comment: Made it 3-3 with a styling performance in C&D Group 3 three weeks ago; makes the shortlist

runners.name: Great Barrier Reef
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten colt; 6l winner on his debut at the Curragh (6f, soft) before following up in the Marble Hill (6f, good), getting the better of his stablemate Carry The Flag, and made it 3-3 when landing the Coventry (6f, good to firm); holes can be picked in that form but this colt can probably be marked up having raced in the far side group; has to be respected.
runners.comment: Made it 3-3 when winning the Coventry and that win can probably be marked up; respected

runners.name: Carry The Flag
runners.spotlight: Narrowly beat Sun Goddess at Naas (5f, good) on his second start and also won a Listed race over that same C&D last month; 7l behind Orthodox in the Norfolk and he faded into fourth after making the running in the Phoenix Stakes (6f, good to firm) last time; has a bit to find to reverse placings with his old rival and there's a suspension he may be better over 5f.
runners.comment: Listed winner over 5f but 7l behind Orthodox in the Norfolk; may be at his best over 5f

runners.name: Tribeca
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut at Navan (6f, good to yielding) in April and was a 3l second of seven in the Railway Stakes at the Curragh last month; however, he's been well held either side of that, including behind Orthodox and Carry The Flag in the Norfolk (5f, good to firm); others preferred.
runners.comment: 3l second in the Railway Stakes but behind Orthodox and Carry The Flag in the Norfolk
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Mrs A O'Callaghan

runners.name: Drazinda
runners.spotlight: Finished behind Senorita Bonita when midfield in the Queen Mary on her second start before going down by a length in a Listed event here of 5f (good to soft); stayed on strongly to get off the mark in a similar event here last time (again over 5f) suggesting step up to this trip would suit; each-way claims.
runners.comment: Stayed on strongly to win a 5f Listed race here latest; stepping up in trip should suit

races.race_name: Sumbe Prix Jean et Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)

runners.name: Diamond Necklace
runners.spotlight: Faultless profile when considering she's unbeaten in six starts, three of them in France and the last four of which have been at Group 1 level; won the Poule d'Essai Des Pouliches, Prix de Diane (Pink Panthera runner-up) and Nassau Stakes this campaign so, with no ground or trip concerns, she's clearly the one to beat.
runners.comment: Unbeaten in six starts, four of them Group 1s, so obvious chance
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Aventure
runners.spotlight: Classy type, who spends most of her time in Group 1 company, more than often running with plenty of credit; drop to a Group 2 saw her win at Longchamp in May (1m2f110yds, good to soft) and should be involved from her low draw.
runners.comment: Races mostly in Group 1s and should be involved from low draw

runners.name: Rebel Moon
runners.spotlight: Won on debut at Gowran in April, when she had stablemate Johanna Walsh back in third, and then went on to land a Group 3 at Naas (1m2f84yds, good); couldn't maintain her superiority over Johanna Walsh last time in the Irish Oaks (1m4f, good to firm) but drop back in trip looks the right move after that; interesting.
runners.comment: Back in trip after fair effort in the Irish Oaks; interesting

runners.name: Pink Panthera
runners.spotlight: Only made debut in December and has come a long way since, her best run coming when beaten a short-neck by Diamond Necklace in the Prix de Diane (1m2f110yd, good to firm) in June; bumped into another top prospect last time in a 1m4f Group 2 and likely to play a part unless those two efforts have taken something out of her; respected.
runners.comment: Pushed Diamond Necklace in the Prix de Diane; has to be respected

runners.name: Timeforshowcasing
runners.spotlight: Had plenty of racing for her age, winning five of her ten starts, and recorded a career best last time on her first try over 1m2f when beaten a nose in the Group 1 Grosser Dallmayr-Preis on good ground; back in against just her own sex and capable of featuring if building on that Munich effort; seems to handle all underfoot conditions.
runners.comment: Career best last time in a race featuring the boys; unexposed at trip

runners.name: Red Letter
runners.spotlight: Winner of a Listed race and Group 3 in Ireland last year over a mile and 1m1f but yet to strike over this distance from four starts, although she's run in decent races every time; heads into this off a career best in the Pretty Polly Stakes (1m2f, good to firm) and should run her race; seems to handle all ground.
runners.comment: One of a few who posted a career best last time; should run her race

runners.name: Cankoura
runners.spotlight: Seventh in this last year, but does have a Listed and a Group 3 win in her profile, plus has been placed at the top level in America and France; didn't need to be at her best to win at Chantilly last time (1m2f110yds, good) but posted a career best at Saratoga prior to that; this is a strong race but she should be in the mix for a place at least.
runners.comment: Career best two runs back; should be in the mix for a place at least

runners.name: Pierchic
runners.spotlight: Smart sort and did gain a career best when third in a 1m1f Group 3 last time, but this is a very hard task unless the new trip brings about lots of improvement from wide draw.
runners.comment: Placed in a Group 3 last time but hard task unless new trip makes a big difference

runners.name: Moments Of Joy
runners.spotlight: Long prices when behind stablemate Diamond Necklace the last two times, and probably in here to make a good pace, albeit she's coming out of stall 11.
runners.comment: Likely to be pushing the pace for favourite, although stall 11 not ideal
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Qilin Queen
runners.spotlight: Capable of smart form, notably when winning the Group 2 Prix de Malleret (1m4f, good to soft) from a decent type last July, but last two starts have been modest and she didn't beat a rival in a York Listed event 30 days ago; bit to prove now.
runners.comment: Smart at her best but below form on her last two runs; bit to prove

runners.name: Beautify
runners.spotlight: Won a Group 2 on her second start as a 2yo and then was Group 1 placed, but struggled since, including in the Irish Oaks last time, and stable have much stronger claims with Diamond Necklace.
runners.comment: Not progressed since Group 1 second last year; hard to make a case for
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor
